# iru_users (Data Source)

Look up users synced from Iru's directory integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Active users from every directory integration.
data "iru_users" "active" {
  archived = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Only archived (`true`) or unarchived (`false`) users.
- `email` (String) Only the user with this email.
- `integration_id` (String) Only users from this directory integration (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Matching users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active.
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the user is archived.
- `department` (String) Department.
- `device_count` (Number) Number of devices assigned.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `integration_id` (String) Directory integration ID (UUID).
- `integration_name` (String) Directory integration name.
- `integration_type` (String) Directory integration type, e.g. `office365`.
- `job_title` (String) Job title.
- `name` (String) Display name.
